flags.why: The literary tag misleadingly excludes ordinary uses describing a clear voice, such as giọng nói rất thanh ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=thanh)).
The common meaning domestic or locally produced, as in hàng nội, is missing ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=n%E1%BB%99i)).
flags.fix: adj | domestic; produced within the country. Example: Tôi thích dùng hàng nội. = I prefer using domestically produced goods.

flags.why: Khối means a solid generally, while khối lập phương specifically means a cube ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=kh%E1%BB%91i)).
